verdict.rationale: The evidence shows building blocks for background automation, not a turnkey automation feature. Webhooks can act "as a trigger to perform an additional action after that event has occurred," but you must build and host your own app to run that action. The only built-in automation shown is narrow: automated sales-tax calculation, filing and remittance. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable workflow/automation builder, scheduled or recurring background jobs, AI-agent-driven autonomous automations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
